name: Cherry
source:
Cherry has a laid-back and open personality. Her job as a barmaid is perfect for her, and she enjoys her work.

Despite her Icarian roots and distinctive appearance, she has adapted well to her new elven surroundings and found a home there.

Her dream is to be a master chef one day and to cook for the queen herself.
